rules.statement: Every document one evaluation reads comes from a single revision (P7).
guards: runtime:DocumentSnapshotViewsTest#a view decides with the revisions it was built from

rules.statement: For one key, installs happen in the order loads started (P6).
Snapshot caches have ttl = null and throw on failed reads; an instance refuses to start when Redis's maxmemory-policy is not noeviction.
guards: cosec-spring-boot-starter:CoSecPipelineAutoConfigurationTest#Redis that may evict snapshots fails startup unless told to warn
cosec-spring-boot-starter:CoSecPipelineAutoConfigurationTest#a maxmemory-policy that cannot be read fails startup unless told to warn

rules.statement: Once the platform's limits or attributes change, every app and tenant document installed afterwards was compiled with them or is compiled again, including one whose load was in flight; one that cannot be compiled again fails closed.
guards: cosec-core:SnapshotRecompileTest#a load that compiled with the old inputs while they changed is compiled again before anyone is served it
cosec-core:SnapshotRecompileTest#a document that cannot be compiled again fails closed until a retry compiles it
cosec-core:SnapshotRecompileTest#a document failed by a recompile keeps retrying while the store stays down
runtime:PlatformCompilerInFlightTest#a document compiled against the previous platform while it changed is compiled again

rules.statement: A tenant configured to fail closed on lag (`cosec.authorization.snapshot.fail-closed.tenants`) is not decided on when the oldest document its evaluation reads was last confirmed by the store longer ago than `fail-closed.max-lag`: the request is indeterminate (503) unless a DENY matches. Other tenants, and views within the bound, are decided as usual.
guards: runtime:DocumentSnapshotViewsTest#a fail-closed tenant past its lag bound is unresolved, others decide
